newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends lower on speculative dlr buying.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends lower on speculative dlr buying.

text.p: The won closed lower on Tuesday on speculative dollar buying combined with some importer deals, traders said.

The won finished at 895.00, compared with Monday's close of 894.50. After opening at 894.90, the won moved in a range of 894.50-896.80. Dealers said the won/dollar rate was expected to drift sideways ahead of an anticipated inflow of foreign funds for investment in the Seoul stock market next month.
Wednesday's mid-rate is expected to be fixed at 895.40 against 894.40 today.
